notes: Exact computed CSS strings or RegExp, including flags and before/after pseudo-elements. Negate with { not: true }; use Deadline.within for timeouts. Missing and multiple matches retry until exactly one matches, including under negation; Playwright rejects multiple matches immediately. Failure evidence retains the computed string or match count.

decision.quote: CSS expectations retry missing and multiple matches until exactly one element matches, even under negation.
